decisions.reason: Premium support is cheap to keep alongside the existing 24/7 service operation and supports the agency-focused strategy, so the option is still worth holding, although it is no longer visible on the website.
The GDPR contract tool costs little to keep online, but it sits far from the core offer and post-GDPR demand has likely levelled off, so its value remains unclear and withdrawal is close to even.
Scalable agency hosting is the flagship product at the center of the firm's strategy and core competence, so the firm should keep investing in it rather than abandon it.
